items.source: Return the last time an actual refresh happened (as timestamp).
items.translation: 返回上次实际刷新发生的时间（作为时间戳）。

items.source: Return the number of actual refreshes since startup.
items.translation: 返回自启动以来的实际刷新次数。

items.source:
Interface to be implemented by dynamic target objects,
which support reloading and optionally polling for updates.
items.translation: 动态目标对象需实现的接口，支持重新加载并可选择轮询更新。
